# Catchlogr

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the shared repository instructions.
Use its task-to-guide table to load only documentation relevant to the change.
Keep shared rules there rather than copying them into this file.
Before editing, read the scoped AGENTS.md listed there for each affected project
and for tests. Path-specific adapters in .github/instructions point to those files.
Select relevant workflows from AGENTS.md's task table without requiring the user
to name them. When native skill discovery is unavailable, read the linked SKILL.md.

If the current Copilot mode cannot read linked files, attach AGENTS.md to the
request together with the affected scoped AGENTS.md. Do not assume a Markdown
link automatically imports its contents.
